usage: organon [-h]
               {init,put,status,review,approve,approval-challenge,challenge,resolve-challenge,gate,review-phase,advance,trace,next-task,run}
               ...

Evidence-linked case workflow. All results are JSON.

positional arguments:
  {init,put,status,review,approve,approval-challenge,challenge,resolve-challenge,gate,review-phase,advance,trace,next-task,run}
    init                Create a case
    put                 Add or revise a case item
    status              Read the current case state
    review              Review an item
    approve             Record human approval of an item
    approval-challenge  Prepare exact bytes for offline human signing
    challenge           Record a contradiction between items
    resolve-challenge   Resolve a recorded contradiction
    gate                Evaluate a phase gate without advancing
    review-phase        Review a phase
    advance             Advance a phase after its gate passes
    trace               Show an item's dependency trail
    next-task           Get bounded instructions for the next phase task
    run                 Apply a resumable workflow manifest until a gate needs
                        a decision

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

usage: organon init [-h] --title TITLE --domain DOMAIN --actor ACTOR
                    [--approval-policy {signed,fixture}]
                    path

positional arguments:
  path                  Case directory

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --title TITLE
  --domain DOMAIN
  --actor ACTOR
  --approval-policy {signed,fixture}
                        signed for real cases; fixture for explicitly
                        synthetic tests

usage: organon put [-h] --kind KIND --text TEXT [--ref REFS] [--data DATA]
                   --actor ACTOR [--expected-version EXPECTED_VERSION]
                   [--expected-deps EXPECTED_DEPS]
                   path id

positional arguments:
  path
  id

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --kind KIND
  --text TEXT
  --ref REFS            Referenced item ID; repeatable
  --data DATA           JSON object with structured fields
  --actor ACTOR
  --expected-version EXPECTED_VERSION
                        Current item version; 0 requires an absent item
  --expected-deps EXPECTED_DEPS
                        JSON object mapping every referenced item ID to its
                        expected version

positional arguments:
  path

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --roles ROLES  JSON object mapping roles to actor labels
